newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says Bre-X, Barrick positive on Busang.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says Bre-X, Barrick positive on Busang.

text.p: A top Indonesian mining official said on Thursday Canada's Bre-X Minerals Ltd and Barrick Gold Corp had responded positively to a government recommendation of a 25-75 split in the Busang gold discovery.

"They are very positive," Umar Said, secretary-general of the mines department, told reporters after meeting representatives of the two companies on Wednesday, the Indonesian deadline for an agreement.

The Mines and Energy Ministry suggested in a letter to the two companies dated November 22 that Bre-X retain a 25 percent stake in the huge gold field in Kalimantan province which the company estimates contains at least 57 million ounces of gold.
The letter suggested that Barrick take a 75-percent stake to develop the find.
The Indonesian government has also sought a 10 percent stake.
"Yes, they want to give 10 percent to the Indonesian government," Umar said when asked about the request.
"The next step is that they have to reach an agreement on a joint venture," he said.
Asked if they had made a positive response to the letter, Umar replied: "Yes."
He said, however, the ministry had not yet received a formal reply from the companies.

The government had set a deadline of December 4 for a response to the letter. Umar has said that if the two companies failed to reach a partnership agreement, the government would explore other ways to expedite development of the Busang find.
